observations.behavior: Adds a wrapper script and a new signal listener to handle SIGTERM and SIGINT without relying on asyncio's self-pipe, which can fail when the pipe is full.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent worker pods from remaining alive indefinitely after a failed shutdown, which could lead to resource exhaustion or orphaned processes. The wrapper script resends SIGTERM until the worker exits, and the signal listener records the signal without depending on the self-pipe. This could help PostHog avoid worker pods remaining alive indefinitely after a failed startup
